title: College of Arms
description: The official English heraldic authority, with guidance on grants, the law of arms, and the character of armorial rights.

title: Court of the Lord Lyon
description: Scottish grants, matriculations, and the Public Register of All Arms and Bearings.

title: Canadian Heraldic Authority
description: Canada's heraldic program, including educational materials and the Public Register of Arms, Flags and Badges.

title: Public Register of Canada
description: Research and discovery of Canadian grants, confirmations, registrations, and approvals. Check reuse restrictions.

title: Scotland's People — Arms
description: Government guide to Scottish armorial research and the evidence needed for claims of descent.

title: Wikimedia Commons
description: Enormous illustrated collection; always inspect each item's provenance, authorship, and licensing individually.

title: The Heraldry Society
description: A major educational charity offering a beginner's guide, historical guidance and publications.

title: Heraldry Society of Scotland
description: Scottish-focused study, events and research, useful alongside the Lord Lyon's official materials.

title: American Heraldry Society
description: A curated English-language heraldic reading list, with special attention to the American setting.

title: Royal Heraldry Society of Canada
description: Heraldry proficiency material and Canadian educational resources.

title: Mortimer History Society
description: A helpful introductory course organized into short modules.

title: Institute of Heraldic and Genealogical Studies
description: Professional distance-learning heraldry instruction and established examination pathways.

title: Heraldry for Beginners — Hatching and Furs
description: A richly illustrated primer from The Heraldry Society, including the hatching system and basic furs.

title: The Herald Painter — Engraving and Colour
description: An artist's discussion of historical and contemporary techniques for reproducing heraldic arms in monochrome.

title: Ireland — Office of the Chief Herald
description: Grants and records administered within the National Library of Ireland's modern framework.

title: South Africa — Bureau of Heraldry
description: Official registration and evidence concerning state and personal arms.

title: Kenya — College of Arms
description: Statutory heraldic services under Kenya's College of Arms Act, distinct from the English College.

title: Malta — Chief Herald of Arms
description: Contemporary Maltese grants and registrations under the Cultural Heritage Act framework.

title: Flanders — Heraldic regulation
description: The Flemish legal framework for personal and institutional arms; distinguish decrees from voluntary associations.

title: Netherlands — Hoge Raad van Adel
description: Noble and public heraldic administrative functions, not automatic oversight of all private family arms.

title: Sweden — Riksarkivet
description: State heraldic advice and public-symbol records; municipal registration has its own PRV procedure.

title: Philippines — National Historical Commission
description: Public heraldic registry and official design work in the national administrative setting.

title: New Zealand — Herald of Arms Extraordinary
description: Institution established in 1978, with liaison to the College of Arms in London.

title: Georgia — Department of State Symbols and Heraldry
description: Institutional guidance for national and civic emblems in Georgia.

title: Czechia — Parliamentary Civic Register
description: REKOS records official municipal arms and flags and their parliamentary decisions.

title: Russia — State Heraldic Register
description: Federal heraldic registration through the presidential administrative framework.
